title: Decoded lower-bound step
statement: Let $s$ be a Boolean list. Its lower-bound step is the pair encoding of the first component decoded from $s$ and the tail obtained by dropping the first entry of the second component decoded from $s$.
caveat: The payload does not specify the decoding functions or the pair encoding.
